name: wheel
title: WHEEL synth engine (tonewheel organ)
summary: Pick WHEEL in the engine list (or the 'wheel' presets): a tonewheel organ with 9 drawbars (16 registrations + bass/body/top trims), single-sine-per-bar additive voices with tonewheel foldback, Hammond-style percussion (2nd/3rd, soft, slow), key click, overdrive and a rotary speaker (horn + drum, slow/fast with spin-up). 8 values (knob push = page 1/2) saved in the preset, page 3 = the sound's FX knobs (reverb/echo amount etc. without leaving the screen); TE's envelope, FX and LFO apply. The preset stays a drwave preset with in-range values (passes TE's boot check, loads on stock firmware as drwave).
controls: engine list: WHEEL; preset browser: folder wheel (one preset, 'wheel'); the sounds are in the built-in bank (shift + blue turn)
WHEEL sound: knob push cycles page 1 (REG PERC DRIVE ROTARY) / page 2 (BASS BODY TOP CLICK) / page 3 (the sound's FX knobs 1-4, as on TE's FX screen)
WHEEL sound: shift + blue turn browses the built-in bank (24 organ sounds)
